agent_bot_ai_init.sql:
-- Apply explicitly to the independent agentBot database. No legacy AI tables are altered.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_ai_provider (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  protocol VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  base_url VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,
  credential_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL,
  enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  description VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uq_provider_name (name)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_ai_model (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  alias VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  upstream_model VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  provider_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uq_model_alias (alias),
  CONSTRAINT fk_agent_bot_model_provider FOREIGN KEY (provider_id)
    REFERENCES agent_bot_ai_provider (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_ai_session (
  execution_id CHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  session_id VARCHAR(256) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  request_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  configured_model VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  model VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  duration_ms BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  usage JSON NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  error_code VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  prompt MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
  content MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (execution_id),
  KEY idx_session_created (session_id, created_at, execution_id),
  KEY idx_created (created_at, execution_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
agent_bot_agent_init.sql:
-- Apply explicitly after agent_bot_ai_init.sql in the independent agentBot database.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_agent_run (
  execution_id CHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id VARCHAR(256) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, request_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  entry VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, model VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, backend VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, duration_ms BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  usage JSON NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, error_code VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  prompt MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL, content MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL, revisions JSON NOT NULL,
  KEY idx_agent_run_created(created_at, execution_id),
  KEY idx_agent_run_session(session_id, created_at, execution_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_agent_step (
  execution_id CHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, sequence INT NOT NULL,
  turn INT NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, tool VARCHAR(200) NULL,
  call_id VARCHAR(256) NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, duration_ms BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  summary VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(execution_id,sequence),
  CONSTRAINT fk_agent_step_run FOREIGN KEY(execution_id) REFERENCES agent_bot_agent_run(execution_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_skill (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL,
  category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, system_prompt MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
  sample_prompt MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL, tools JSON NOT NULL,
  enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_mcp (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL,
  category VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, transport VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  endpoint VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, credential_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL,
  allowed_tools JSON NOT NULL, search_tool VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  timeout_seconds INT NOT NULL, required TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_agent (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL,
  system_prompt MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL, model_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  tools JSON NOT NULL, max_steps INT NOT NULL, options JSON NOT NULL,
  enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT fk_agent_model FOREIGN KEY(model_id) REFERENCES agent_bot_ai_model(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_agent_skill (
  agent_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, skill_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(agent_id,skill_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_agent_skill_agent FOREIGN KEY(agent_id) REFERENCES agent_bot_agent(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_agent_skill_skill FOREIGN KEY(skill_id) REFERENCES agent_bot_skill(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_bot_agent_mcp (
  agent_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, mcp_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(agent_id,mcp_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_agent_mcp_agent FOREIGN KEY(agent_id) REFERENCES agent_bot_agent(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_agent_mcp_mcp FOREIGN KEY(mcp_id) REFERENCES agent_bot_mcp(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
